description: Observation model: P(EVENT_OCCURRED=1 | domain_state). Links latent domain activation state to observed event occurrence (binary). One row per domain. In v1.0 the emission probabilities are symmetric across all 5 domains — differentiated in M5-D fitting.
derivation: Initial values from DBN_TOPOLOGY_v1_0.md §3.4. P(EVENT|ELEVATED)=0.70 reflects that elevated periods are where major life events concentrate (LL.4 training base). P(EVENT|NORMAL)=0.20 reflects background rate. P(EVENT|SUPPRESSED)=0.05 reflects suppression blocks event occurrence.
n1_disclaimer: Symmetric priors at n=1. Per-domain differentiation in M5-D fitting. Preliminary calibration target: calibration_slope ≥ 0.7 per LL.4 PREDICTION_PRIOR training.

entries.ll4_basis: career MODERATE prior mean_lit=0.5016 suggests non-trivial baseline; ELEVATED threshold reflects event concentration in high-signal antardashas
health MODERATE prior mean_lit=0.4948; symmetric with CAREER at v1.0; health events may require asymmetric adjustment at M5-D
relationship MODERATE prior mean_lit=0.4113; lower domain prior than career/health may push fitted ELEVATED value down at M5-D

spiritual WEAK prior (n=6 combined SPR+PSY, mean_lit=1.0 unreliable after split); SPIRITUAL captures dharmic practice events (SPR.*); symmetric scaffold pending M5-D per-domain fit. U2 split: SPIRITUAL receives existing scaffold values; PSYCHOLOGICAL receives new node.

PSYCHOLOGICAL — new 5th domain (U2 split from SPIRITUAL_PSYCHOLOGICAL). n_obs insufficient for separate prior (PSY.* events subset of n=6 combined). Symmetric scaffold: ELEVATED=0.70, NORMAL=0.20, SUPPRESSED=0.05. Domain captures psychological transformation events (8H Ketu activation, 4H Moon distress periods). M5-D fitting will differentiate from SPIRITUAL per-domain.
